The main takeaway from our work is that
the time-varying setting requires a fundamentally new approach, and we propose two algorithms that are tailored to the setting of unknown time-varying dynamical systems.
, for the problem of online control of time-variant dynamics, the class of Youla policies is strictly more powerful than the other two classes.
for the time-varying setting with unknown dynamics, the choice of control policy is critical, as there are no universal policies that can achieve low regret for all systems.
